review_boundary: Claims below were checked against current SAP primary sources. This does not change page-level verified, robots, sitemap, or publication status.

claims.claim: The Advanced ATP Check API performs a simulated aATP check without creating an order or a persisting reservation. Current 2025 documentation lists PAC, PAL, SUP, BPS, and ABC among the supported important methods.

Supply Protection protects quantities for defined demand groups. In the availability check it can restrict quantities available to other groups, so a sales order can be partly confirmed or not confirmed.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA advanced Available-to-Promise, Supply Protection

claims.claim: Product Allocation and Supply Protection are complementary aATP controls: PAL defines an upper allocation limit while Supply Protection protects minimum quantities. Poorly aligned characteristic groups can cause the controls to restrict each other.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA advanced Available-to-Promise, PAL and SUP

claims.claim: In SAP S/4HANA 2025 FPS01, Next Generation JIT Supply to Customer supports end-to-end integration of sequenced JIS calls from the sales scheduling agreement through invoice, including EWM and TM integration.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Next Generation Just-In-Time Supply to Customer

claims.claim: In the nJIT supply-to-customer outbound process, an outbound delivery can be created from the S2C call. TM then creates freight units from that outbound delivery and transportation can continue with warehouse-driven or transport-driven execution.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA nJIT, Logistics Execution, TM and EWM integration

claims.claim: Joule brings AI assistants and agents into a common SAP experience. SAP describes it as embedded into work across SAP and non-SAP systems, with a conversational UI, contextual business information, access controls, governance, analytics, and extensibility mechanisms.

SAP AI Core is a service on SAP BTP for standardized execution and lifecycle management of AI assets. The generative AI hub is a capability of SAP AI Core and SAP AI Launchpad for governed access to and orchestration of generative AI models; it extends rather than replaces the AI Core runtime foundation.
claims.product_scope: SAP AI Core and generative AI hub

claims.claim: Sales Billing can create, change, and cancel billing documents, post them to Financial Accounting, and output them through multiple channels.
Copying control governs which reference documents can create which billing documents, copying requirements, billing quantity, field transfer, and whether pricing is copied or redetermined.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Sales Billing

claims.claim: Billing pricing can copy prices from the sales document or perform pricing again; the pricing type is controlled in copying control.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Sales Billing

claims.claim: When collective billing is requested, the system tries to combine selected due items according to split criteria rather than blindly producing one invoice.
Split analysis can compare two billing documents and show differing header fields and partners that explain why the documents were split.
Credit checks can run at different points from sales order processing through delivery. The check applies a check rule and its assigned steps, and a negative result can block the order or delivery.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Sales and SAP Credit Management

claims.claim: A check rule is assigned to the business partner credit profile and contains one or more check steps. Check steps can evaluate values such as credit limit utilization, credit exposure, dunning level, or oldest open item.

Credit exposure for SD documents represents the credit amount of outstanding documents and is used in static and dynamic checks. Completed documents are not included even when an undelivered quantity remains.
SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition is operated and maintained by SAP, uses a more standardized configurable functional scope, and SAP manages its software upgrades.

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition has a functional scope and upgrade flexibility comparable to SAP S/4HANA. SAP publishes a new software version every two years and installs upgrades at the customer request within the maintenance obligations.
For SAP S/4HANA on-premise, the customer manages software and hardware updates and decides whether and when to upgrade. Its software release cycle is parallel to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition.

Developer extensibility in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 is available in a three-system landscape and uses a cloud-optimized ABAP subset, released SAP APIs and objects, and predefined extension points. RAP and ADT are part of this developer-extensibility model.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition developer extensibility

claims.claim: RAP business objects use CDS view entities as the data-model basis. In managed implementation, the RAP provider supplies standard transactional behavior and buffering; in unmanaged implementation, the developer implements the transactional behavior and buffer, which supports reuse of existing business logic.

SAP MDG Data Quality Management supports derivation rules, validation rules, data-quality KPIs, scheduled evaluations, monitoring, drilldown, and correction for product and business-partner master data. These are implementation mechanisms for governed data quality; they do not define the enterprise ownership model by themselves.
claims.product_scope: SAP Master Data Governance, Data Quality Management

claims.claim: MDG validation rules are managed in a central rule repository and can be used for data-quality evaluations and checks in change requests, consolidation, and other MDG processes. The rule implementation can therefore support preventive and detective controls, while ownership and acceptance thresholds remain governance decisions.

A warehouse task is the EWM execution document for goods movements or stock changes such as picking, putaway, internal movements, posting changes, goods receipt, or goods issue. It can reference a warehouse request or exist without one for some internal movements.
A warehouse order is an executable work package that groups warehouse tasks or physical inventory items. Warehouse order creation rules control how tasks are grouped for warehouse execution.

Releasing a wave can create warehouse tasks for stock removal or internal movements. EWM then creates warehouse orders from those tasks to form work packages, and task creation updates the referenced warehouse request and document flow.

Goods receipt and invoice receipt for valuated procurement are linked through the GR/IR clearing account. The invoice posting clears the GR/IR amount against the vendor-side posting, so operational receipt and financial invoice completion are separate events that must reconcile.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement / Financial Accounting

claims.claim: Production-order settlement transfers actual order costs to one or more receiver cost objects according to the settlement rule. A settlement rule contains distribution rules that define receiver, share, and settlement type, so production completion does not by itself prove that controlling settlement is complete.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Product Cost by Order

claims.claim: A movement type defines the business purpose of a goods movement and controls important Inventory Management behavior such as quantity updates, stock and material valuation, consumption accounts, input fields, and some subsequent documents.

Physical inventory separates the count from the posting of differences. SAP supports posting differences after a recorded count or entering the count and posting the difference in one step, so a completed count alone does not prove that book stock was corrected.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management and Physical Inventory

claims.claim: SAP Integration Suite is an integration platform on SAP BTP for cloud, on-premise, and hybrid scenarios. Its current capability landscape includes process integration with Cloud Integration, API management or composition, business events, B2B integration, third-party connectivity, migration assessment, and customer-managed edge execution options.

SAP Event Mesh supports asynchronous publish-and-consume business events and decoupled communication across applications. Advanced Event Mesh adds distributed event streaming, event management, monitoring, and event-broker capabilities for larger event-driven landscapes.
claims.product_scope: SAP Event Mesh and SAP Integration Suite, Advanced Event Mesh

claims.claim: Guaranteed delivery can redeliver a message. End-to-end exactly-once behavior therefore needs duplicate handling or an idempotent receiver in addition to retry-capable delivery.
An exception subprocess that ends with a message end event can leave message monitoring in Completed status even though an exception occurred.
qRFC administration uses SMQ1 and SMQ2 for outbound and inbound queue monitoring and SMQS and SMQR for scheduler administration.
bgRFC units can be transactional or queued; queued units use FIFO processing and are monitored with SBGRFCMON.
WE02 can inspect IDoc data and status records, while BD87 can trace and reprocess selected IDocs after the underlying error is resolved.
SAP AIF supports error correction followed by restart or reprocessing for supported interfaces; the operational decision still depends on interface design and business ownership.

Batch management preserves lot identity across logistics processes. SAP shows batch determination, availability and usability checks in Sales and batch assignment or determination in Production, so batch is a cross-process material identity rather than a warehouse-only attribute.

A handling unit is a uniquely identified packaging unit that carries the packed materials and can carry batch and serial-number information through the supply chain. Serial numbers identify individual material instances and can be assigned to HU items, so HU identity and serial identity solve different traceability problems even when they travel together.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Logistics - Handling Unit and Serial Number Management

claims.claim: SAP MDG on SAP S/4HANA 2025 FPS01 offers classic mode and cloud-ready mode. Classic mode covers a broad set of central-governance, consolidation, data-quality, and master-data domains, while cloud-ready mode currently supports the Business Partner domain and uses a cloud-ready extensibility approach.
claims.product_scope: SAP Master Data Governance on SAP S/4HANA

claims.claim: Switching on cloud-ready mode enables its apps but disables classic-mode consolidation and mass-processing apps and related functions. Processes created in classic mode can continue in cloud-ready mode, while processes created in cloud-ready mode cannot be continued after switching back to classic mode.
claims.product_scope: SAP Master Data Governance cloud-ready mode

claims.claim: The Data Replication Framework is used to define and execute replication from SAP S/4HANA or MDG to connected target systems. Replication models combine target systems with outbound implementations and can use filters, so successful governance and successful downstream distribution are separate responsibilities.
claims.product_scope: SAP Master Data Governance / Data Replication Framework

claims.claim: MDG separates governed staging and activation from replication to consuming systems. The data model and replication design therefore need an explicit active-data and downstream-distribution boundary; a completed change process alone does not prove that every target system can use the mastered object.

A production version selects the alternative BOM together with the task list or master recipe and carries lot-size and validity restrictions. SAP uses production versions in planning and order creation to choose the suitable production technique.

Goods receipt for a manufacturing order posts the finished material to stock and reduces the expected receipt. The order is credited by the goods movement and the cost flow follows the order settlement rule, so physical completion and cost settlement are related but not the same checkpoint.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Production Orders and PP/DS integration

claims.claim: SAP pricing uses the condition technique. A condition type can have an access sequence that searches condition tables in a defined order until a valid condition record is found; the pricing procedure then arranges the relevant condition types and calculation steps.

Pricing procedure determination combines sales-area context with document and customer pricing indicators. Therefore a wrong procedure can be caused upstream by determination inputs even when the individual condition records themselves are correct.

Automatic source determination can evaluate maintained sources and source-control objects such as purchasing info records, outline agreements, source lists, and quota arrangements. A selected supplier is therefore the result of source-of-supply logic and master data, not merely the vendor entered on the final purchase order.

Purchase-order item category and account-assignment category solve different control problems. Item category shapes the procurement scenario and item processing, while account assignment determines which cost object or account receives the value when the purchase is not simply posted to valuated stock.

The usage decision confirms completion of the inspection lot and records whether the inspected goods are accepted or rejected. It can also trigger follow-up actions, so it is a quality disposition decision rather than only a comment on results.

For a stock-relevant inspection lot, stock can be posted during usage-decision processing and SAP creates the corresponding material-document postings. A non-stock-relevant lot cannot use the usage-decision stock-posting functions.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Quality Management and Inventory Management

claims.claim: Shipping-point determination uses shipping condition, loading group, and delivering plant as key inputs. The shipping point is an organizational execution unit for deliveries and shipping activities, so an unexpected shipping point should be diagnosed from those inputs before changing the delivery.

Classic route determination evaluates transportation-relevant origin, destination, shipping-condition, and material transportation-group context. Route and scheduling are related but separate decisions: the route can supply transit and transportation-lead-time data used by transportation and delivery scheduling.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Delivery Management

claims.claim: Sales document item category determination uses document and material context, including the sales document type and the material's item-category group, with additional controls such as usage or a higher-level item category where configured. The resulting item category controls important item behavior.

Schedule line categories control delivery-relevant and requirements-related behavior at schedule-line level. Standard determination uses the sales item category together with MRP-related material context, so a schedule-line problem should be traced through item-category and material-planning inputs before changing the final order line.

The Sales Order A2X OData V2 API is a synchronous inbound service for external applications and supports creating, reading, updating, and deleting sales orders. An API endpoint is therefore a command/query contract, not the same thing as asynchronous business-event publication.

The Sales Order business object publishes events for creation, change, deletion, and overall-processing-status change. These events carry business identifiers and status context, so event-driven consumers should use the event as a notification contract rather than assume it contains the full mutable sales-order state.

A standard sell-from-stock flow connects sales order, outbound delivery, picking and goods issue, and delivery-related billing. Billing transfers accounting-relevant data into Financial Accounting, so commercial, physical, and financial completion are separate checkpoints in one end-to-end process.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Sales

claims.claim: In the sales-order outbound-delivery scenario, the sales order item is the root for subsequent logistics process steps. Outbound delivery, picking, packing, goods issue, and billing expose different process statuses; posting goods issue is the final delivery-processing step and delivery-related billing uses the delivery as its main reference.

TM creates freight units from transportation-demand documents such as order-based or delivery-based transportation requirements, orders, deliveries, and JIT calls. Freight orders are a result of transportation planning and become capacity and execution documents used for later carrier-related processing.

A freight settlement document represents freight-document costs from TM to MM. Posting it can create the service purchase order and service entry sheet that form the basis for carrier invoice verification, so freight execution and financial settlement are distinct completion layers.
claims.product_scope: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management and Materials Management

claims.claim: In an external-planning scenario, transportation requirements can be sent as freight units or consignment orders and planning results returned as freight orders or freight bookings. SAP documents TransportationOrderGenericRequest_Out and _In as the communication APIs for this exchange.

The Freight Order A2X API can create, update, and cancel freight orders and can assign or unassign freight units, report events, and calculate charges. SAP also warns not to use this API to update freight orders during the planning and subcontracting phase of SAP_COM_0414 because later external-planning replication can overwrite those updates.

SAP Architecture Center describes MCP as the standard for agent-to-tool interaction and SAP agent architecture uses semantically enriched, governed access to SAP business capabilities. Tool access therefore does not remove the need for business semantics, controlled exposure, and validation around the underlying capability.
claims.product_scope: SAP BTP agent architecture and MCP access to SAP business capabilities

claims.claim: SAP agent architecture treats agent identity as a governed enterprise identity with authentication, scoped authorization, policy enforcement, and auditability. Agent capability and permission are separate concerns, and access must stay inside explicit authorization boundaries.
claims.product_scope: SAP enterprise AI agent identity and authorization architecture
